sample_unit: questions (12 questions and 4 vignettes as reported; 17 graded)

links.outcome: Appropriateness of ChatGPT breast cancer screening answers for women 75+, graded by expert panel
links.effect: Appropriate for 11/17 questions (64%); 3 inappropriate (18%), 2 unreliable (12%), 1 no consensus (6%).
links.quote: The responses generated by ChatGPT were appropriate for 11/17 questions (64%).

links.outcome: Consistency of ChatGPT responses across three repeated runs of the same questions
links.effect: Two of 17 questions (12%) were graded unreliable because content was inconsistent across the three responses; 3 (18%) were inappropriate.
links.quote: Three questions were graded as inappropriate (18%) and 2 questions were graded as unreliable (12%).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy/appropriateness of ChatGPT on breast cancer screening vignettes and questions without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
